#!/bin/sh
# gnomon [audit.attest] signer (ADR-0006). gnomon writes a 64-char head digest to stdin and
# reads a base64 Ed25519 signature from stdout. The private key never enters the repository
# or the gnomon surface: it lives in ~/secrets (override with GNOMON_AUDIT_KEY).
#
# Off-box anchor: each signed head is also mirrored to Central Brain through cb-gx10 log, so
# a copy exists where a writer of .gnomon-audit/ cannot reach it (gnomon README, attest limit 2).
# The mirror is best-effort and never blocks signing; a missed mirror is visible in the console.
set -eu
key="${GNOMON_AUDIT_KEY:-$HOME/secrets/gnomon-audit/ed25519.pem}"
tmp=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
cat > "$tmp"
sig=$(openssl pkeyutl -sign -rawin -inkey "$key" -in "$tmp" | base64 -w0)
printf '%s' "$sig"
if command -v cb-gx10 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  digest=$(cat "$tmp")
  cb-gx10 log --source phdlab --kind gnomon.audit_head --project phdresearch --agent gnomon \
    --payload "{\"session_id\":\"gnomon-audit\",\"digest\":\"$digest\",\"signature\":\"$sig\"}" \
    >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
EOF
